messages:
alex: Quick review — proposing a lightweight mini-tour banner + sample project cards on first-run. Figma links in thread. Quick Qs: should banner be persistent or dismissible? Any accessibility or engineering concerns?

maria: Lean dismissible + a clear 'reopen' affordance in the header. Copy thought: use concise action-first language. Example: `Try a sample project — deploy in minutes` or shorter `Start with a sample project`.

samir: Engineering constraints: if persistent we must avoid LCP impact. Plan: lazy-load banner assets, defer images until after first paint, and avoid heavy fonts. Also recommend a small client-side flag to skip showing after first successful quickstart run.

kevin: Checklist idea for the first-run modal: three micro-steps shown inline so users can scan quickly. 1) Create API key, 2) Run quickstart (link), 3) Inspect trace in Console. Steps should be collapsible for advanced users.

aria-a11y: Accessibility nits from initial pass: ensure when the mini-tour opens there's no focus trap that prevents screenreader navigation; Esc should dismiss, and 'reopen' must be keyboard focusable with aria-controls/aria-expanded states. Current CTA contrast measures ~3.9:1 — target >=4.5:1. Also ensure sample project cards have meaningful alt text and role=button for card-level activation.

samir: Example of the lightweight banner payload I had in mind:
```json
{
  type: 'mini-tour',
  cta: 'Try sample project',
  persistent: false,
  showcase: ['todo-app', 'qa-bot', 'doc-summarizer']
}
```
Keep it tiny; we can render cards client-side from the lightweight list.

maria: Design tweaks: reduce visual chrome on cards, show micro-copy under project titles like 'JavaScript • 2 min setup'. Use a subtle dotted divider between checklist items. I'll prototype high-contrast CTA variants and a dark-mode pass.

design-bot: Figma export uploaded: https://figma.redwood/workspace/mini-tour-export (auto-screenshots + spec tokens).

alex: Good notes — action items: maria to update copy + CTA contrast by Wed, samir to add lazy-load + client flag, aria-a11y to draft a keyboard/voiceOver test plan, kevin to mock 'reopen' link in header. We'll review Fri sync. Thanks! :thumbsup:
